verdict.rationale: OpenAI maintains an API changelog that records both model changes (new reasoning models, GPT-5.5's capability set) and API/platform changes (key expiration, admin key-creation controls, new agent and voice features). The changelog also points to a standing deprecations page with dated shutdowns and recommended replacements. missing for 10: evidence of a subscription mechanism (RSS/email feed) for following updates, independent or community corroboration that the changelog is reliably maintained.
